question.text:
For the reaction sequence given below, the correct statement(s) is(are)
(In the options, $X$ is any atom other than carbon and hydrogen, and it is different in $\mathbf{P}, \mathbf{Q}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ )

options.text: C-X bond length in $\mathbf{P}, \mathbf{Q}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ follows the order $\mathbf{Q}>\mathbf{R}>\mathbf{P}$.
C-X bond enthalpy in $\mathbf{P}, \mathbf{Q}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ follows the order $\mathbf{R}>\mathbf{P}>\mathbf{Q}$.
Relative reactivity toward $\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{N}} 2$ reaction in $\mathbf{P}, \mathbf{Q}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ follows the order $\mathbf{P}>\mathbf{R}>\mathbf{Q}$.
$\mathrm{p} K_{\mathrm{a}}$ value of the conjugate acids of the leaving groups in $\mathbf{P}, \mathbf{Q}$ and $\mathbf{R}$ follows the order $\mathbf{R}>\mathbf{Q}>\mathbf{P}$.

solution.text: (A) Wrong: bond length order $\mathrm{Q}>\mathrm{P}>\mathrm{R}$ (B) Correct: Bond enthalpy $\mathrm{R}>\mathrm{P}>\mathrm{Q}$ (C) Wrong: $\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{N}} 2$ reactivity $\quad \mathrm{Q}>\mathrm{P}>\mathrm{R}$ (D) Wrong: $\mathrm{pKa}(\mathrm{HI} <\mathrm{HBr} <\mathrm{HF}) \quad \mathrm{R}>$ P $>\mathrm{Q}(\mathrm{pKa})$
